claim_boundary.allowed: the external C_q accumulator over these q-conditioned, residue-blind provenance walks did or did not exceed the two frozen cyclic controls
does_not_claim: rational phases operate in aligned MoO
the provenance walk is a runtime path or orbit
Q/Z is a ring under rational multiplication or division
a return excess proves circle geometry
failure in this aperture disproves every phase lens

exact_step_permutation.comparison_arithmetic: exact Fraction; decimals are serialization aids only
exact_step_permutation.conditioning: each path keeps q, length, graph selection, endpoint, and its exact residue multiset; only within-path order is permuted independently
exact_step_permutation.name: exact_step_multiset_order_permutation

stratified_label_shuffle.comparison_arithmetic: exact Fraction; decimals are serialization aids only
stratified_label_shuffle.conditioning: paths remain fixed; residues are shuffled only among selected occurrences with equal q, source-stage bin, floor(log2 exposure), and floor(log2 distinct-other shared-input hub degree)
stratified_label_shuffle.name: q_stage_exposure_hub_stratified_label_shuffle

decision.kill_interpretation: the current provenance-order hypothesis is killed in this frozen aperture only when primary identity and resolution checks pass, the aperture is sufficient, and either cyclic control is not exceeded

external_transport_definition.group: ordinary finite cyclic additive group C_q
external_transport_definition.path_score: R(P) = count of t in [1, path_length-1] for which X_t = 0
external_transport_definition.reason_endpoint_excluded: the endpoint is invariant under permutations of the exact step multiset

failure_modes_and_limits: caps can truncate occurrences, outgoing arcs, or accepted paths; all truncation is reported
exact-stage/exposure/hub strata can make labels immutable, triggering the aperture guard
shared-input adjacency is a graph-composable evidence relation, not a recorded rational transition
paths are q-conditioned and residue-blind, not phase-blind across denominators
occurrence-disjoint paths can still share input or result neighborhoods and are not independent runtime trials
a negative result is aperture-specific; a positive result remains counterfactual and non-runtime
the probe aborts rather than silently relaxing hard scan, adjacency, path, or null-work caps

graph_corpus.checkpoint_scope: every source-node, source-edge, exposure, and witness query is restricted to stage <= checkpoint
graph_corpus.connection: SQLite URI mode=ro with PRAGMA query_only=ON

strict_alignment.operand_rule: both operands must be confirmed positive-spine integers no later than the source edge stage

occurrence_cap.policy: lowest deterministic SHA-256 ranks of q and canonical source-edge content; residue labels and SQLite insertion ids are unused

paths.seed_policy: deterministic SHA-256 rank of seed, q, and canonical source-edge content; DFS follows the q-conditioned residue-blind degree-capped neighbor order
paths.split_policy: SHA-256(seed, q, complete canonical source-edge sequence) parity: even discovery, odd holdout; SQLite insertion ids are excluded

provenance_dag.definition: occurrences are adjacent iff their exact source division edges share a confirmed input node; arcs require a strictly increasing source stage
provenance_dag.hub_degree_definition: number of distinct other selected occurrences sharing either exact input, before orientation and outgoing-degree truncation
provenance_dag.neighbor_ranking: deterministic SHA-256 of seed, q, and canonical source/target edge content; residue, return state, and SQLite insertion ids are excluded
provenance_dag.orientation: strictly increasing source stage; same-stage pairs are unoriented

graph_selection.selection_description: residue-blind conditional on exact order q

observed_holdout_statistic.definition: proper-prefix return count divided by path_length-1, averaged within q and then equally across holdout q values

division.arithmetic_rule: recorded result must equal the exact Fraction(left)/Fraction(right)
division.division_branch_prediction: for strict integer a/b, g=gcd(abs(a),abs(b)), predicted q=abs(b)/g, and predicted C_q residue=(a/g) mod q; this reduced transport coordinate is distinct from the full abs(b)-branch torsion fibre
division.exposure_scope: checkpoint-scoped incoming edges only for eligible division result ids
division.full_torsion_preimage_prediction: retaining integer divisor b gives abs(b) preimages under mu_b, and integer source lift a selects branch a mod abs(b)
division.scope: all recorded division occurrences with stage <= 80

*.conditional_relation: A retained integer operand n defines the external scalar action mu_n; the quotient class [n] does not retain that scalar.

/.conditional_relation: Division by a retained nonzero integer n selects one preimage under mu_n; the phase input alone does not select it for abs(n) > 1.
